description: Silver Jackets Program is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USACE Flood Risk Management Program. Silver Jackets are interagency teams that facilitate collaborative solutions to state, territory, or tribe flood risk priorities Teams comprising multiple agencies learn from one another and apply their knowledge to reduce the risk of flooding and other natural disasters in the United States. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General. Assets: Critical Facilities, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
